system.description:
• Effect: Delivered by a Sneak Attack against your Studied target once it has had the study a Death Attack needs: on a hit that deals damage, the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or dies instantly.
  • Death Attack works only on a target whose Level does not exceed your Assassin level plus 2.
  • Against a solo, a failed save is a kill effect: it loses its next two turns (see Solo Creatures, Book IV).
  • Save succeeds: attack deals the maximum on its Sneak Attack dice instead
